name: Lakeshore West
description: A Lakeshore train-connection and rail-replacement family, including Hamilton–Aldershot–Burlington feeders and selected through trips to Union. Former Brock branch 18K became route 11.

timeline.event: GO’s first Lakeshore West feeder connected Oakville and Hamilton via Burlington.
The original table documents Hamilton feeders and early route-18 trip series through to Union.
Routes 15 and 18 are explicitly identified in the Lakeshore West booklet.
Weekday 18K extended the Hamilton corridor to Brock University via Niagara communities.

gaps: The 1970 table code 1 is not evidence that the bus was then numbered 18.
Temporary construction variants are not all captured by these selected documents.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
